purpose: We develop and validate a risk model that predicts hospital admission in heart failure from kidney function trajectories. The model needs individual-level histories; aggregated statistics are not sufficient.
question: Provide pseudonymised conditions and eGFR values for adults with heart failure who have at least one eGFR value.
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Heart failure = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with I50.
Cohort = adults with heart failure who have at least one eGFR value (LOINC 62238-1).
Report the size of the cohort you would make available.
